importantFindings: Mainship 30 Pilot received a real 2003 Series II production phase because keel, draft, propulsion and interior changed without a new base model identity.
Mainship 34 Diesel Cruiser, 34 II and 34 III remain separate named canonical models/variants; they are not collapsed into production phases.
Mainship 350 and 390 are the same continuing trawler model line under a 1999 rename; B-Atlas keeps both searchable records but explicitly links their continuity.
Mainship 400 Trawler, 41 Expedition and 414 Trawler are explicit renames of one model line and are represented by naming production phases/aliases.
Monk 36 remains one canonical model across the Taiwan-to-Nova Scotia builder transition; builder, exterior teak, aft-head layout and power changes are represented as production phases.
Island Gypsy 32 Fisherman shares the Sedan hull mold but is a distinct named model/variant with different mission, weight and power.
Island Gypsy 36 Classic is explicitly associated with the 36 Quad Cabin alias and retains single/twin engine ambiguity.
Island Gypsy 44 Motor Cruiser legacy aft-cabin classification was corrected: published layout places the master amidships.
